notes.title: Update Patch Notes - September 27, 2021
notes.notes:
The following updates have been implemented:


Fixed: Murky Achievement

Fixed: Steam Overlay + F12 Screenshot problem.

Added: Selectable stage theme (Grassy, Muddy, Snowy or Random) You can find it at the bottom of the screen on the MODE SELECT.


Big Thanks to Antoine G. @__sleepingpanda for help with Steam Overlay problem and Baltus for bugs report.


Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi
